scripts.compile: esbuild main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:electron --external:electron-updater --outfile=dist/main.cjs && esbuild security.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist/security.test.cjs && esbuild preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload.cjs
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
scripts.release:dist: npm run release:check && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --config.forceCodeSigning=true
